title: Company DescriptionMTK Technologies is a premier HR solutions and services organ
text:
Company DescriptionMTK Technologies is a premier HR solutions and services organization providing quality, skilled manpower to clients in various industries. Established in 2006, we are committed to becoming a pioneer in providing recruitment services globally.
Role DescriptionThis is a full-time hybrid role located in Alpharetta, GA, with flexibility for some hybrid work as a Software Engineer in Test. The Software Engineer in Test will be responsible for developing and executing automated tests, maintaining and improving test frameworks, collaborating with developers to improve software quality, and identifying and documenting software defects.
QualificationsTechnically Sound in Core Java-Selenium, TestNG.BDD.Develop Framework components & script development for automated tests.Good with writing SQL queries.Exposure to REST API & Automation.Working in Agile Methodology.Closely work with Dev teams & create test cases.Build & Release process (CICD implementation knowledge).Ready to learn different types of Frameworks.Good to have-UNIX, Python
